label: Required existential-production edge
definition: A mixed edge from the bearer of an occurring act to that act, or from an occurring act to a bearer whose existence it produces. There are no same-sort edges.
note: This graph adapter records only the comparisons required by the existing two priority interfaces. It uses the occurrence guard and production-of-being predicate of DEF-NO-EXISTENTIAL-SELF-PRODUCTION. It is stipulative and its edges need not themselves compose.
